scope.method: The main agent fetched current production HTML successfully over HTTP. Local Playwright parsed those snapshots with JavaScript disabled and all external requests aborted. The longest main element contains the streamed server-rendered page; the first main is a loading fallback. This is source-content verification, not an interactive or visual QA pass. The root agent also fetched all eight production vessel detail pages successfully over HTTP and parsed their specification definition lists and image descriptions; their source artifacts are referenced individually.
limitations: Public web-reader attempts returned false-negative inaccessible errors; successful direct-fetch HTTP 200 snapshots are the production evidence.
No credentials, CMS API, database reads, writes or deployments were used.
The five current English pages were reviewed; current Thai pages were not independently captured.
